stemBlocks.value: Calculate (6.4 × 10⁵)/(8 × 10²), giving your answer (i) exactly and (ii) in standard form.
Think first: Treat the front numbers and the powers of ten as two separate divisions, then tidy the format at the end.

stemBlocks.altText: Source visual for edmar-csec-p010-q12 from workbook page 10.

contentBlocks.value: Move the point one place right and reduce the index by 1

strategyBlocks.value: Divide 6.4 by 8, subtract the indices of the powers of ten, then shift the decimal point so the front number lies between 1 and 10.

whyThisWorks.value: Powers of the same base divide by subtracting indices, because every shared factor of ten cancels. Standard form then demands a front number a with 1 ≤ a < 10, so 0.8 × 10³ must be rewritten; each place the point moves right is compensated by one less in the index, keeping the value identical.
